# Welcome {.unnumbered}

These are the course notes for **MA505: Introduction to SAS**.

Each chapter matches one class session. The same notebook is used to make that day's slides, so the slides and the book always stay in sync.

All code runs in **SAS OnDemand for Academics**, a free version of SAS Studio that runs in your browser. See the *Setting up SAS* guide on Moodle to create your account.

## Slides {.unnumbered}

- [Introduction to SAS](slides/01-intro-to-sas.html)
- [SAS Tables and Libraries](slides/02-tables-libraries.html)
- [Exploring Data with Procedures](slides/03-procedures.html)
- [Formats, Sorting, and the DATA Step](slides/04-format-sort-datastep.html)
- [Conditional Processing and Plotting](slides/05-conditional-plotting.html)
- [More Plots: SGPLOT, SGPANEL, and Exporting](slides/06-sgplot-sgpanel.html)
